# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the start of the story; dies a few years later  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Agatha Sowerby’s husband’s neighbor  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed was an unusual-appearing man with an awkward frame and a hunching back. He had lengthy iron-gray hair reaching his shoulders—which turned silver in his final years—and wore a thick, gentle brown beard continuously from the age of twenty. When traveling, he wore his finest suit with a white collar.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c36 P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Obed was an extremely timid, bashful, and quiet man who hated being surrounded by unfamiliar people or conversing unnecessarily. He possessed a deep-seated fear of women and young girls, fearing they were quietly mocking him. Despite his extreme shyness, he possessed a soft, gentle nature, deep empathy, and a tender heart. He preferred taciturn solitude or loquacious companions who handled all the conversation without requiring his participation.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)_

- Provide a good home for Nell and support her ambitions  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c32 P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041)</sub>

## History

Due to advancing age, heart trouble, and difficulties securing hired farm labor, Obed and his sister Thirza decided to adopt an eleven-year-old orphan boy from Nova Scotia. Obed drove to the station at Alder River to retrieve the boy, but due to a mix-up in messages, a red-haired orphan girl named Nell Harcourt was delivered instead. Unable to abandon her, Obed brought her home and quickly grew fond of her lively chatter and imaginative spirit. Over Thirza's initial objections, Obed advocated for keeping Nell, forming a deep and affectionate bond with her. Throughout her childhood, he quietly supported and indulged Nell, buying her a stylish dress for Christmas despite his extreme dread of female shopkeepers. He took immense pride in Nell's academic success and achievements, including her winning the Avery scholarship. In his later years, his health deteriorated further alongside worries regarding the stability of the local bank holding his savings. Obed passed away peacefully at home and was buried in Brierley, leaving a lasting memory of love and understanding in Nell's heart.

## Background by volume

- Raised at Grey Shutters, built by his equally bashful father on the outer border of his cleared property  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Grew his beard at the age of twenty and kept it ever since  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Lived his entire adult life with his sister Thirza at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Suffered from heart trouble  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
